output.sql:
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(o.shipping_fee), 0), 2) AS shipping_fees_eur
FROM marts.fct_orders AS o
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: Totals the shipping fees (EUR) on completed orders with an order date in 2025. Shipping fees are reported separately here and are not part of revenue.
